lead: A result page: a large icon (or error code), a title, a description and actions, centred. For an operation that succeeded or failed, and for whole-page states such as 404 / 403 / 500.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `result.css`; the status colours are the theme style's semantic colours (success / danger / warning / primary).
styling.icon: Icon container (in the status colour); for 403 / 404 / 500 it holds the large error code
styling.extra: Actions area; the content block with a light background
